output.title: OUTPUT
output.desc: Connect a formula value OR an exec chain. Use Branch to split paths.

attr_score_val.title: Attr Score
attr_score_val.desc: Live numeric value of this attribute (read-only, always present in attribute graphs).

attr_output.title: ATTR OUTPUT
attr_output.desc: Attribute widget output. Wire modValue to set what the modifier button shows and rolls.

skill_rank_val.title: Skill Rank
skill_rank_val.desc: Live numeric value of this skill rank (read-only, always present in skill graphs).

skill_output.title: SKILL OUTPUT
skill_output.desc: Skill widget output. Wire modValue to set what the bonus button shows and rolls.

init_on_roll.title: On Initiative Roll
init_on_roll.desc: Fixed entry point fired when initiative is rolled. The compiled formula from this graph is used as the world initiative formula.

init_output.title: INITIATIVE OUTPUT
init_output.desc: Initiative formula output. Wire Initiative value (a roll value or number) to set the world initiative formula.

branch.title: Branch
branch.desc: If Condition is TRUE runs True path; otherwise False path

on_click.title: On Click
on_click.desc: Entry point — fired when the item's Use button is pressed. Connect its exec output to your action chain.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.desc: Run N exec branches in strict order (1 → 2 → … → N). Set `count` to pick how many branches; connected + 1 is the smallest safe count.

get_path.title: Get Field Value
get_path.desc: Read any field from the actor or item by dot-path. Outputs the value at the given path.

get_widget.title: Get Widget Value
get_widget.desc: Read the current computed value of another widget by its Widget Key

get_widget_path.title: Get Widget Path
get_widget_path.desc: Emits the data path bound to a widget (e.g. system.flags.hp). Feed into Set Field / Modify to change the widget's value from the graph.

get_name.title: Get Name
get_name.desc: Returns the display name of an Item, Widget, Token, Actor or Sheet by UUID, ID, widget key, or name. Pick a Kind to constrain the lookup, or leave it on Auto to try each kind in order. The Ref pin (if connected) overrides the static reference.

slot_count.title: Slot Count
slot_count.desc: Count items in a slot. Slot is auto-indexed — pick from dropdown or connect a Get Actor Slot ID node.

slot_field.title: Slot Item Field
slot_field.desc: Field on item at index inside a slot (0=first)

item_uuid.title: Item by UUID
item_uuid.desc: Drag an item from the sidebar here to get its UUID, then read a field

target_field.title: Target Field
target_field.desc: Read a field from the first targeted/selected token's actor

fa_icon.title: FA Icon
fa_icon.desc: Font Awesome icon picker — single text output containing a ready-to-render `` HTML snippet. Drop it into Chat Output, a Richtext widget or a Text widget (sheet renders the icon for plain FA snippets) and it appears as an actual icon, not as the literal class text.

attr_mod.title: Attr Modifier
attr_mod.desc: Calculates the modifier from an attribute score using the world setting `modifierFormula` (halved / direct / none). Default: floor((score − 10) / 2). Connect Attr Score → score pin.

dice.title: Dice
dice.desc: Build a dice formula `<count><die>`. Die accepts any size — type "d5", "d87", "5", "87" or a {ref}. Optional Min / Max clamp the rolled result to a [min..max] range (leave blank to skip). Outputs: `Formula` (string for rolling), `Min` / `Max` (theoretical extremes — handy for HUD ranges or branch logic), `Avg` (expected value).

formula_range.title: Formula Range
formula_range.desc: Statically inspect a dice formula and emit its theoretical Min, Max and Average. `2d6+3` → min=5, max=15, avg=10. Works with any formula string — useful for HUD ranges, IF branches, or feeding clamps.

formula_clamp.title: Formula Clamp
formula_clamp.desc: Wrap a formula with `max(MIN, min(MAX, F))`. Either bound may be left empty (open on that side). Stack multiple Clamp nodes to apply tighter ranges in sequence.

formula_mul.title: Formula × N
formula_mul.desc: Wrap a formula in `(N)*(F)`. Common case: crit doubling (`×2`). Set N=2 + leave Formula pin connected = doubled total.

to_formula.title: To Formula
to_formula.desc: Strip surrounding quotes from a string and mark it to be inlined into a dice formula raw, without JSON quoting. Use this when a field contains a roll expression (e.g. `1d6`, `2d20+@mod`) that should be rolled as dice instead of being treated as a literal text term. Plain text values still work — they are simply emitted unquoted into the formula.

formula_add.title: Formula + Mod
formula_add.desc: Append a +/- modifier to a formula. Mod accepts numbers (`5`, `-3`) or expressions (`@mod`, `1d4`). Stack multiple of these to chain bonuses.

roll_stat.title: Roll Stat
roll_stat.desc: Produce a percentile (0..1) showing where the roll landed inside its theoretical range, plus echo Min/Max/Avg of the formula. Useful for heatmap UI or `If pct >= 0.9 → great hit`.

eq.desc: Equality check. Works for both numbers (5 == 5) and text ("hello" == "hello", Cyrillic / Latin / Unicode).

neq.desc: Inequality check. Works for both numbers and text (Cyrillic / Latin / Unicode).

match_num.title: Match Number
match_num.desc: Compare Value against each Case (top→bottom) by numeric equality and emit the matching Result. Cases and Results are independent input pins — wire any value (field, formula, literal) to each one. If no Case matches, the Default value is emitted (empty if not connected). Result pins accept any type (number / text / array / formula).

match_str.title: Match Text
match_str.desc: Compare Value against each Case (top→bottom) by exact string equality and emit the matching Result. Cases and Results are independent input pins — wire any value (field, formula, literal) to each one. If no Case matches, the Default value is emitted (empty if not connected). Result pins accept any type (number / text / array / formula).

match_arr.title: Match Array
match_arr.desc: Compare Value against each Case (top→bottom) by exact CSV-string equality ("a,b,c") and emit the matching Result. Cases and Results are independent input pins — wire any value (field, formula, literal) to each one. If no Case matches, the Default value is emitted (empty if not connected). Result pins accept any type (number / text / array / formula).

act_roll_value.title: Roll → Value
act_roll_value.desc: Rolls dice and forwards the numeric result as a value output. When Roll dialog is enabled, a Disadvantage/Normal/Advantage picker opens first, each option using the formula from its corresponding pin. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls. Outputs: Result (final sum), Formula (resolved string), Min/Max/Avg (theoretical bounds & expected value), Dice Array (every active die's value as a CSV array — pipe into Array Join / Array Length / Get Element / Filter to inspect individual die results, e.g. 2d6 → "3,5"). For crit / fumble logic use Attack Check or Roll Check — Roll Value is intentionally just numbers and dice.

act_damage.title: Damage
act_damage.desc: Apply damage to target HP. Reads target's system.resistances[damageType] and scales the amount (immune=×0, resist=×0.5, vulnerable=×2, numeric factor used as-is). halfOnSave × savePassed halves damage when the preceding save passed. Three amount slots — Amount (base), Crit Amount (used when Is Crit? truthy), Fumble Amount (used when Is Fumble? truthy). Wire e.g. Roll Value's Is Crit / Crit Formula straight into Is Crit? / Crit Amount. Connect Targets pin from AoE Save / AoE Targets to apply to specific tokens.

fields.label: Crit Amount (used when Is Crit? is true)
Fumble Amount (used when Is Fumble? is true)

act_heal.title: Heal
act_heal.desc: Apply healing to target HP. postToChat:yes → chat card with Apply button. autoApply:yes → post to chat AND immediately heal (no click). postToChat:no → silent direct HP write. Three amount slots — Amount (base), Crit Amount (used when Is Crit? truthy), Fumble Amount (used when Is Fumble? truthy). Connect Targets pin from AoE Save to apply to specific tokens.

fields.label: Crit Amount (used when Is Crit? is true)
Fumble Amount (used when Is Fumble? is true)

act_effect.title: Apply Effect
act_effect.desc: Create or toggle an Active Effect on actor/target. Changes: JSON array [{key,value,mode}] where mode 2=Add 5=Override. Connect Target pin (single actor) or Targets pin (array) to override the field.

act_effect_uuid.title: Apply Effect (UUID)
act_effect_uuid.desc: Apply an existing Active Effect to actor/target by UUID. Pick from the dropdown — UUID is filled automatically. Connect Target pin (single actor) or Targets pin (array) to override the field.

for_each_target.title: For Each Target
for_each_target.desc: Execute loop body once per targeted token. Use Set Target (multi-target with T) before activating.

act_for_each_token.title: For Each Token
act_for_each_token.desc: Execute loop body once per token id in a comma-joined list (e.g. Saved[]/Failed[]/All[] from Save Branch). On each iteration {__currentTarget} = current token id and {__loopIndex} = i; the current token's actor becomes the action context.

tok_field.title: Token Field
tok_field.desc: Read a field from the actor of a token by token id. Token Id defaults to {__currentTarget} (set by For Each Token / per-target iterators). Use to read e.g. system.resources.hp.value of a specific saved/failed token.

arr_length.title: Array Length
arr_length.desc: Number of token ids in a comma-joined list (e.g. Saved[]/Failed[]/All[] from Save Branch).

arr_at.title: Token at Index
arr_at.desc: Returns the Nth token id (0-based) from a comma-joined list (Saved[]/Failed[]/All[] etc.). If Index is out of range, returns empty.

arr_map_field.title: Map Field
arr_map_field.desc: For every token in the array, read the same field from its actor and return all values as a new comma-joined list. Use to feed numeric arrays into Aggregate / Find / Filter or to compare values across tokens.

arr_aggregate_field.title: Aggregate Field
arr_aggregate_field.desc: Reduce a numeric field across all tokens in the array. Sum / Avg / Min / Max / Count. Non-numeric values are skipped.

arr_find_extreme.title: Find Top by Field
arr_find_extreme.desc: Returns the token id of the actor with the highest (max) or lowest (min) field value in the array. Useful for `who has more HP`, `slowest initiative`, etc.

arr_filter.title: Filter by Field
arr_filter.desc: Keep only tokens whose actor field passes `field <op> value`. Numeric comparisons when value parses as a number, string equality otherwise. Outputs a comma-joined list to feed back into other Array / For Each Token nodes.

arr_compare_two.title: Compare Two Tokens
arr_compare_two.desc: Read the same field on two tokens and route exec into Greater / Less / Equal based on (A − B). Diff outputs the numeric difference and Winner outputs the id of the higher token (empty on tie).

arr_sort.title: Sort by Field
arr_sort.desc: Sort token ids by a numeric actor field. Ascending or descending. Tokens with non-numeric values go to the end.

arr_slice.title: Slice / Take
arr_slice.desc: Take a sub-range of an array. Start is 0-based; Count of -1 means «to the end». Use after Sort to get top-N / bottom-N.

arr_concat.title: Concat
arr_concat.desc: Join two arrays end-to-end (duplicates kept). For unique union use Union node.

arr_union.title: Union
arr_union.desc: All ids present in A or B (unique).

arr_intersect.title: Intersect
arr_intersect.desc: Only ids present in BOTH A and B. «Tokens that are buffed AND poisoned».

arr_difference.title: Difference
arr_difference.desc: Ids in A that are NOT in B. «Targets that did not save».

arr_contains.title: Contains
arr_contains.desc: Returns 1 if Token id is present in the array, 0 otherwise. Useful for branches.

arr_distinct.title: Distinct
arr_distinct.desc: Remove duplicate ids preserving first-seen order.

arr_make.title: Array Make
arr_make.desc: Build a new array from up to 8 individual values. Empty / unconnected slots are skipped. Output is a comma-joined list compatible with all other Array nodes.

arr_split.title: Array From String (Split)
arr_split.desc: Split a string into an array using a custom separator. Default separator is comma. Useful when you have a stored CSV value or want to convert a manually-typed list into an array.

arr_join.title: Array Join (to String)
arr_join.desc: Concatenate array elements into a single string using a custom separator. Default separator is `, `. Useful for chat output / flavor text from a built array.

arr_push.title: Array Push
arr_push.desc: Append one element to an array and return the new array. Original array is not mutated. Empty Element is skipped (returns the array unchanged).

arr_get.title: Array Get (generic)
arr_get.desc: Generic version of `Token at Index` — works for ANY array (strings, numbers, ids). Supports negative indices: `-1` returns last, `-2` second-to-last, etc. If index is out of range and a Default is supplied, it is returned instead.

arr_first.title: Array First
arr_first.desc: Return the first element of an array (`arr[0]`). Empty if the array is empty.

arr_last.title: Array Last
arr_last.desc: Return the last element of an array (`arr[-1]`). Empty if the array is empty.

arr_reverse.title: Array Reverse
arr_reverse.desc: Reverse the order of elements. Original array is not mutated.

arr_sum_num.title: Array Sum (numeric)
arr_sum_num.desc: Sum of numeric elements in an already-numeric array (e.g. produced by `Map Field` or `Array Make` with numbers). Non-numeric elements are skipped. Returns 0 for empty arrays.

arr_avg_num.title: Array Average (numeric)
arr_avg_num.desc: Average of numeric elements. Non-numeric elements are skipped. Returns 0 if there are no numeric elements.

arr_min_num.title: Array Min (numeric)
arr_min_num.desc: Lowest numeric element. Returns 0 for empty / non-numeric arrays.

arr_max_num.title: Array Max (numeric)
arr_max_num.desc: Highest numeric element. Returns 0 for empty / non-numeric arrays.

arr_random_pick.title: Array Random Pick
arr_random_pick.desc: Pick `count` random elements (without repetition). Default count is 1 and returns a single element as the value. Count > 1 returns an array.

arr_filter_generic.title: Array Filter (by element)
arr_filter_generic.desc: Generic filter that compares each element of the array directly to a value (no actor.path). Operators: `==`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`. Numeric ops cast elements to numbers; string ops use case-sensitive substring matching.

arr_map_formula.title: Array Map (formula)
arr_map_formula.desc: Apply a formula to every element of an array. Inside the formula, `{__elem}` is replaced with the current element, and `{__elemIndex}` with its 0-based index. Each result is evaluated by the formula engine. Useful for `array * 2`, `floor(array/3)`, conditional transforms, etc.

arr_for_each.title: For Each Element
arr_for_each.desc: Generic version of `For Each Token` — execute a body once per element of an arbitrary array (strings, numbers, anything). On each iteration `{__loopItem}` = current element, `{__loopIndex}` = i. After all iterations, exec goes to Done.

get_spell_slots.title: Spell Slots
get_spell_slots.desc: (Removed) Spell Slots node has been retired. Use Get Field Value on the relevant resource path instead.

act_restore_slot.title: Restore Slot
act_restore_slot.desc: (Removed) Spell-slot restore has been retired together with the Spell Slots node. Use Modify Field on the relevant resource path instead.

act_apply_effect_template.title: Apply Effect Template (legacy)
act_apply_effect_template.desc: Legacy — use Create Effect or Chat Apply Effect instead.

act_modify.title: Modify Field
act_modify.desc: Add / subtract / set any field on self, actor or target. The Actor pin (when wired) overrides the Where dropdown — feed it a UUID, a Get Actor / Get All Targets node, or any actor expression. An array of actors loops the change over each. Path / Where / Op can all be fed dynamically — when wired, the matching field hides UE-style.

act_set_text_field.title: Set Text Field
act_set_text_field.desc: Write a string/text value to any path on self / actor / target. The Actor pin (when wired) overrides the Where dropdown. An array of actors loops the write over each. Use this for non-numeric writes — chat AI responses to a notes field, paste a label, fill a description, etc. Modify Field is for numbers; this is for text. Where can be fed dynamically (UE-style — when the Where pin is wired the dropdown hides). Value supports module tokens ({widget:KEY}, {@attr1}, {item:Sword.system.notes}) and runtime tokens ({__lastAiResponse}, {__lastAiError}, {__lastRoll}).

act_set_initiative.title: Set Initiative
act_set_initiative.desc: Set or roll initiative for the target actor in the active combat. Mode `roll` rolls the system formula; `value` sets the exact number. If the actor isn't in combat, a combatant is created (only for the active combat). Mode can be fed via pin (UE-style: when wired the field hides).

act_add_item.title: Add Item
act_add_item.desc: Add a world item (drag UUID from sidebar) as a copy to the actor's inventory. Optionally restrict to an inventory widget.

act_add_slot.title: Add to Slot
act_add_slot.desc: Add an actor-owned item to a slot on this item or actor. Item and Slot are auto-indexed from the document.

act_remove_slot.title: Remove from Slot
act_remove_slot.desc: Remove an item from a slot by slot ID. Slot is auto-indexed.

act_remove_item.title: Remove Item
act_remove_item.desc: Remove an owned item from actor inventory. Item is auto-indexed — pick from dropdown. Optionally scope to a widget.

act_add_item_array.title: Add Item Array
act_add_item_array.desc: Add every item from an array (UUIDs or owned names/ids) as copies to the actor's inventory. Feed a Compendium Item UUIDs node or any value.array of item references. Qty per item can be set. Optionally scope to an inventory widget.

act_remove_item_array.title: Remove Item Array
act_remove_item_array.desc: Remove every item listed in the array (matches by name, id, or UUID source name) from the actor's inventory. Optionally scope to an inventory widget.

item_arr_names.title: Item Array Names
item_arr_names.desc: Resolve each ref in an array of items (UUIDs / owned ids / names) and return their display names as a comma-joined array.

item_arr_map_field.title: Item Map Field
item_arr_map_field.desc: For every item in the array, read the same field path and return all values as a comma-joined array. Use to feed numeric arrays into Aggregate / Find / Filter.

item_arr_aggregate.title: Item Aggregate Field
item_arr_aggregate.desc: Reduce a numeric field across all items in the array. Sum / Avg / Min / Max / Count. Non-numeric values are skipped.

item_arr_filter.title: Item Filter by Field
item_arr_filter.desc: Keep only items whose field passes `field <op> value`. Numeric comparisons when value parses as a number, string equality otherwise. Outputs a comma-joined list to feed back into other Items / Array nodes.

item_arr_sort.title: Item Sort by Field
item_arr_sort.desc: Sort item refs by a numeric field. Ascending or descending. Items with non-numeric values go to the end.

item_arr_find_extreme.title: Item Find Top by Field
item_arr_find_extreme.desc: Returns the ref of the item with the highest (max) or lowest (min) field value in the array.

act_use_slot_item.title: Use Slot Item
act_use_slot_item.desc: Calls item.use() on the item sitting at [index] in a slot. Slot is auto-indexed.

act_use_item.title: Use Item
act_use_item.desc: Find an owned item by name and call item.use(). Item is auto-indexed from actor inventory.

act_equip.title: Equip Item
act_equip.desc: Mark an owned inventory item as equipped. Runs canEquip() requirements check; blocks on concentration conflict. If Force is on, skips the check.

act_unequip.title: Unequip Item
act_unequip.desc: Mark an owned inventory item as unequipped.

act_modify_slot_item_field.title: Modify Slot Item Field
act_modify_slot_item_field.desc: Add / subtract / set a field on the item sitting at [index] in a slot. Slot is auto-indexed. Path / Op can be fed via pins (UE-style).

act_modify_inv_item_field.title: Modify Inventory Item Field
act_modify_inv_item_field.desc: Add / subtract / set a field on an actor-owned item. Item is auto-indexed from actor inventory. Wire the Actor pin to look up the item on a different actor (UUID / Get Actor / Get All Targets — array loops over each actor). Path / Op can be fed via pins (UE-style).

inv_item_field.title: Inventory Item Field
inv_item_field.desc: Read a field from an actor-owned item. Item is auto-indexed from actor inventory.

slot_item_uuid.title: Slot Item UUID
slot_item_uuid.desc: Outputs the UUID of the item at [index] in a slot. Slot is auto-indexed.

get_actor_slot_id.title: Get Actor Slot ID
get_actor_slot_id.desc: Reference a slot by ID — connect to the Item Slot pin on Slot Count, Add/Remove from Inv Item Slot nodes to dynamically select which slot to operate on.

inv_item_slot_count.title: Inv Item Slot Count
inv_item_slot_count.desc: Count of items in a slot on an actor-owned inventory item. Item and slot are auto-indexed. Connect Get Actor Slot ID to override slot.

act_remove_from_inv_item_slot.title: Remove from Inv Item Slot
act_remove_from_inv_item_slot.desc: Find an item in actor's inventory, then remove one item from its slot. Both item and slot are auto-indexed — just pick from dropdowns. Connect Get Actor Slot ID to Item Slot pin to override.

act_add_to_inv_item_slot.title: Add to Inv Item Slot
act_add_to_inv_item_slot.desc: Find a container item and add another inventory item into its slot. Pick container from dropdown, drag item to add from sidebar.

act_attack_check.title: Attack Check
act_attack_check.desc: Roll attack vs target AC. Branches into Hit / Miss / Crit exec paths and posts result to chat. Roll Result carries the raw dice total; Margin = total − AC. Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic (e.g. Compare against natural d20 from a Roll Value). Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls.

act_roll_check.title: Roll Check
act_roll_check.desc: Generic roll with a chosen comparison rule: roll_over (roll ≥ DC), roll_under (≤ DC), meet_and_beat (> DC, tie = fail), troika (success when roll is higher OR lower than target, depending on targetRule), custom (your own condition via {roll}/{dc}/{margin}). Branches into pass/fail and returns Roll / Margin. opposed:yes — after the initiator rolls, N 'Roll as Opponent' buttons appear in chat; the higher total wins (tie goes to the initiator). Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls.

act_tiered_roll.title: Tiered Roll
act_tiered_roll.desc: Rolls dice and routes exec into one of 4 tiers by thresholds. PbtA 2d6 example: T1 ≤6 (miss), T2 7-9 (partial), T3 10+ (full). Blades example: T1 crit fail, T2 partial, T3 full, T4 crit. Thresholds are arbitrary lower-bounds (inclusive). If result ≥ threshold of a tier, it takes that tier (top-down). Raw result is emitted on Roll. Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls.

act_dice_pool.title: Dice Pool
act_dice_pool.desc: Rolls N dice of a chosen size and counts successes by comparison rule. Outputs: pass/fail based on `required`, Successes, Botches, Raw. WoD example: count=5, die=10, target=8, compare=ge → count d10s that rolled ≥8. Botches = how many d10s equalled botchFace. Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls.

act_spend_token.title: Spend Token
act_spend_token.desc: Spends N tokens from the given resource. If there aren't enough tokens, exec takes the Empty branch. Works like Consume Resource but with branching. Where / Path / Label can be fed via pins (UE-style — when wired the matching field hides).

act_gain_token.title: Gain Token
act_gain_token.desc: Adds N tokens to the resource. Handy for FATE points / Drama dice / stress. Where / Path / Label can be fed via pins (UE-style).

get_token_count.title: Get Token Count
get_token_count.desc: Pure source node: reads the current token count at the given resource path.

act_progression.title: Progression Roll
act_progression.desc: Catches a fresh roll, compares with the previous value stored at History Path, and branches on Higher / Lower / Equal / No History. Writes the new roll back into History Path so next call compares against it. Useful for escalating dice, PbtA session clocks, 'raise / see' mechanics, etc. Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls.

act_throw_on_canvas.title: Throw on Canvas
act_throw_on_canvas.desc: Rolls N dice and visually scatters them on the canvas (PIXI overlay on the active scene). Results are available as successes/total and via {__lastSuccesses}/{__lastRoll}. Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls.

act_throw_on_sheet.title: Throw on Sheet
act_throw_on_sheet.desc: Rolls N dice and visually scatters them over the DOM of the current actor sheet. Results are available as successes/total and via {__lastSuccesses}/{__lastRoll}. Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the chat card; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the source actor each time the player rerolls.

act_ai_request.title: AI Request (OpenAI-compatible)
act_ai_request.desc: POSTs an OpenAI-compatible chat-completion request to the given URL with Authorization: Bearer <key>. Compatible with api.openai.com, openrouter.ai, LM Studio (http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions), Ollama OAI compat, vLLM, etc. Output 'Response' carries choices[0].message.content as a string. Use {__lastAiResponse} in downstream formulas / text. SECURITY: API key is stored on the document where the graph lives — visible to all owners. Use 'API key setting' to read from a world setting (sd.<settingKey>) instead.

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: sk-... (leave empty if using API key setting)

fields.label: System Prompt
fields.placeholder: e.g. You are a helpful Foundry VTT NPC.

fields.label: Prompt
fields.placeholder: e.g. Generate a tavern name and 3 rumours.

switch_node.title: Switch
switch_node.desc: Compare Value against each Case label and jump to the matching exec output. Falls through to Default if no match.

dialog_switch.title: Dialog Switch (legacy)
dialog_switch.desc: Show a dialog with 2-8 named options. The player picks one and that exec branch fires. Outputs are named via fields.

dialog_select_array.title: Dialog Select Array (legacy)
dialog_select_array.desc: Show a dialog with one button per element of the input array. The chosen element is emitted on `Selected` (value), the index on `Index`, and Selected→ exec fires after pick. Cancel → Cancel exec.

dialog_text_input.title: Dialog Text Input (legacy)
dialog_text_input.desc: Show a single-line text input dialog. The entered text is emitted on `Text` and OK exec fires.

act_dialog_builder.title: Dialog Builder
act_dialog_builder.desc: Visual form-dialog builder. Pick element count (1-8), then for each element choose its type (label/section/text/number/checkbox/select/button), a unique Id, a Label, optional default and options. Each element with an Id exposes an output value pin that resolves to the runtime token {__dlg.<id>} (use it anywhere downstream — paths, formulas, text). Buttons additionally expose a per-button exec output when 'Emit exec on click?' is set to yes; turning it off hides that exec pin. Picked outputs the id of the last button clicked. Submit fires after any button (or OK if no buttons exist); Cancel fires on close without confirm.

dialog_confirm.title: Dialog Confirm (legacy)
dialog_confirm.desc: Show a Yes/No confirmation dialog. The matching exec branch fires.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.desc: Execute Loop body while Condition is truthy. Re-evaluates the condition each iteration. Done fires when the condition becomes false or Max Iterations is reached.

act_create_effect.title: Create Effect
act_create_effect.desc: Creates an ActiveEffect on the target actor. Configure name, icon, duration, and attribute changes. Target resolves from pin or falls back to selected tokens / self.

act_apply_status.title: Apply Status
act_apply_status.desc: Apply / remove / toggle a status condition (CONFIG.statusEffects). Status Id can be e.g. `dead`, `prone`, `poisoned`, etc. — anything the active system or world registers. Status Id / Mode / Overlay pins override the matching field (UE-style).

act_remove_effect.title: Remove Effect
act_remove_effect.desc: Removes all ActiveEffects matching the given name from the target actor.

act_toggle_effect.title: Toggle Effect
act_toggle_effect.desc: Toggles the disabled state of an ActiveEffect matching the given name on the target actor.

has_effect.title: Has Effect?
has_effect.desc: Outputs 1 if the target actor has an active (non-disabled) effect with the given name, 0 otherwise.

act_place_aura.title: Place Aura — With Effect
act_place_aura.desc: Places a Scene Region attached to the owner token. Tokens inside receive the named Active Effect automatically (hook-based enter/exit); leaving tokens lose it (configurable).

act_place_aura_damage.title: Place Aura — Damage
act_place_aura_damage.desc: Attaches a region to the owner; rolls damage against tokens inside (onEnter / eachTurn / both). Respects system.resistances[damageType]. Chat card + visibility configurable.

act_place_aura_heal.title: Place Aura — Heal
act_place_aura_heal.desc: Attaches a region to the owner; heals tokens inside (onEnter / eachTurn / both). HP path configurable. Chat card + visibility configurable.

act_place_aura_save_effect.title: Place Aura — Save → Effect
act_place_aura_save_effect.desc: Attaches a region to the owner; tokens inside roll a save (onEnter / eachTurn / both). On failure the named Active Effect is applied. On leave the effect is removed (configurable).

act_place_aura_targets.title: Place Aura — Targets
act_place_aura_targets.desc: Attaches a region to the owner; tokens inside are forwarded as targets — no save, no roll. Each token that enters (or sits in, if eachTurn is enabled) the area runs the postActions chain with itself as the only target. Connect the Targets[] output to a downstream Damage / Heal / Apply Effect node's Targets pin to apply to everyone in the aura.

act_place_aura_save_branch.title: Place Aura — Save Branch
act_place_aura_save_branch.desc: Attaches a region to the owner; tokens inside roll a save (onEnter / eachTurn / both). Connect Saved[]/Failed[]/All[] value outputs to the Targets pin of downstream Damage / Heal / Effect nodes (per-tick, per-token).

act_place_aoe_effect.title: Chat AoE — With Effect
act_place_aoe_effect.desc: Posts a chat card with a 'Place Template' button. Once placed, tokens inside gain the named Active Effect (removed on leave, configurable).

act_place_aoe_damage.title: Chat AoE — Damage
act_place_aoe_damage.desc: Posts a chat card with a 'Place Template' button. Once placed, rolls damage against tokens inside (onEnter / eachTurn / both). Respects resistances.

act_place_aoe_heal.title: Chat AoE — Heal
act_place_aoe_heal.desc: Posts a chat card with a 'Place Template' button. Once placed, heals tokens inside (onEnter / eachTurn / both).

act_place_aoe_save_effect.title: Chat AoE — Save → Effect
act_place_aoe_save_effect.desc: Posts a chat card with a 'Place Template' button. Once placed, tokens inside roll a save (onEnter / eachTurn / both); on failure, the named Active Effect is applied. On leave the effect is removed (configurable).

act_place_aoe_targets.title: Chat AoE — Targets
act_place_aoe_targets.desc: Posts a chat card with a 'Place Template' button. When placed, every token inside is collected — no checks, no rolls. Connect Targets[] to downstream Damage / Heal / Effect nodes' Targets pin to apply effects to everyone in the area.

act_place_aoe_save_branch.title: Chat AoE — Save
act_place_aoe_save_branch.desc: Posts a chat card with a 'Place Template' button. When placed, every token inside rolls a save. Connect Saved[]/Failed[]/All[] value outputs to the Targets pin of downstream Damage / Heal / Effect nodes.

act_remove_aura.title: Remove Aura
act_remove_aura.desc: Removes the aura(s) matching the given key from the owner token and clears the linked Active Effect from any tokens currently inside.

gate.title: Gate
gate.desc: Exec passes through only when Condition is truthy. Acts as an early-exit guard without needing a Branch.

reroute.desc: Visual wire re-routing point. No logic — just keeps graphs tidy.

ternary.title: Ternary
ternary.desc: Outputs True value when Condition is truthy, False value otherwise. Equivalent to (cond ? a : b). Eliminates common Branch→Output patterns.

random_num.title: Random
random_num.desc: Output a uniformly random integer between Min and Max (inclusive). Re-evaluated each time the formula runs.

get_var.title: Get Variable
get_var.desc: Read a named variable stored on this actor (actor.flags.sd.vars.NAME). Use with Set Variable to pass data between button clicks or graph segments.

pow.title: Pow ^
pow.desc: A raised to the power of B

sign.title: Sign
sign.desc: Returns -1, 0 or +1 based on the sign of A

act_play_sound.title: Play Sound
act_play_sound.desc: Play a sound file via Foundry's AudioHelper. Path is relative to the Data folder or a full URL. Src / Volume / Loop can all be fed via pins.

act_run_macro.title: Run Macro
act_run_macro.desc: Execute a world Macro by exact name. The macro runs with the current actor and token as speaker context. Macro name can be fed via pin.

act_notify.title: Notify
act_notify.desc: Show a toast notification (info / warning / error) to the current user. Useful for feedback without a full chat message. Both Message and Level can be fed via pins.

act_consume_resource.title: Consume Resource
act_consume_resource.desc: Decrement a resource value by Amount (default 1). If current value would go below 0 takes the Empty branch instead. Path can be fed dynamically (UE-style — when wired, the field hides). Use instead of Modify Field + Branch for uses/charges/mana.

act_set_var.title: Set Variable
act_set_var.desc: Store a value in actor.flags.sd.vars.NAME (or world settings) for retrieval later. Useful for persisting roll results between button presses. Name and Scope can be fed via pins (UE-style — when wired the matching field hides).

act_open_sheet.title: Open Sheet
act_open_sheet.desc: Open the sheet window of another Actor or Item by UUID. Useful for 'Inspect' buttons on slot items. UUID and Require-ownership can be fed via pins.

act_roll_table.title: Roll Table
act_roll_table.desc: Roll on a world RollTable. Found→ fires when at least one result is drawn. Empty→ fires when the table is empty or not found. Result text and index available as value outputs. Use drawCount > 1 to draw multiple entries — {__rollTableIndex} tracks the current draw (0-based).

chat_save_button.title: Save / Check Button
chat_save_button.desc: Posts a chat card with an interactive 'Roll Save' or 'Roll Check' button. The target player clicks it to roll 1d20 + modifier vs the configured DC. Works like dnd5e saving throw / ability check prompts in chat. Connect pass/fail exec branches for follow-up actions. The button supports any attribute path, skill path, or custom modifier field. Crit / Fumble are external bool inputs — wire them from your own comparison logic. Reroll button (yes/no) adds a Re-roll button to the resulting roll message; Reroll Path / Reroll Cost optionally consume a numeric resource from the rolling actor each time they reroll.

on_update.title: On Update
on_update.desc: Fires whenever this document (actor/item) is updated. Useful for reacting to HP / resource changes.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_create.title: On Create
on_create.desc: Fires once when this document is created.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_delete.title: On Delete
on_delete.desc: Fires when this document is about to be deleted.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_turn_start.title: On Turn Start
on_turn_start.desc: Fires at the start of this actor's combat turn.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_turn_end.title: On Turn End
on_turn_end.desc: Fires at the end of this actor's combat turn.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_combat_start.title: On Start Combat
on_combat_start.desc: Fires once when a combat encounter begins (this actor must be one of the combatants).

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_combat_end.title: On End Combat
on_combat_end.desc: Fires when a combat encounter is deleted/ends (this actor must be one of the combatants).

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_effect_apply.title: On Effect Apply
on_effect_apply.desc: Fires when an Active Effect is applied to this actor.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_damage_taken.title: On Damage Taken
on_damage_taken.desc: Fires when this actor's HP path decreases. Configure the HP path below.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_rest.title: On Rest
on_rest.desc: Fires when a rest flag is set on this actor (configurable flag path).

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_equip.title: On Equip
on_equip.desc: Fires when an item on this actor (or this item specifically) is equipped.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_unequip.title: On Unequip
on_unequip.desc: Fires when an item on this actor (or this item specifically) is unequipped.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_event.title: On Event
on_event.desc: Declarative event trigger: pick the event type from the dropdown. Equivalent to the specific On-* nodes but keeps the graph compact when you only need a single exec chain.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

get_self.title: Get Self
get_self.desc: Reference to the document the graph runs on (actor for sheet graphs, item for item graphs).

get_actor.title: Get Actor
get_actor.desc: Reference to one or more actors. If a UUID is filled in, it takes priority and the Mode dropdown is ignored. Otherwise the Mode resolves at runtime: self/actor (the graph's owner), targeted/selected token, all targets (array), or the user's character.

fields.label: UUID
fields.placeholder: Actor.abc123 (priority — Mode is ignored when filled)

get_target.title: Get Target
get_target.desc: First targeted token's actor. Use Get All Targets for multi-target workflows.

get_selected_token.title: Get Selected Token
get_selected_token.desc: First currently-selected token on the canvas. Falls back to self if none selected.

get_all_targets.title: Get All Targets
get_all_targets.desc: All currently targeted tokens as an array. Feed into For Each Target, AoE save branches, etc.

get_player_actors.title: Get Player Actors
get_player_actors.desc: Returns the array of player-character actors. Feed into Dialog Select (Array) to let the user pick a PC, or into For Each Token / array nodes.

get_user_character.title: Get User's Character
get_user_character.desc: Returns the actor assigned to the current user (game.user.character). Empty if the user has no assigned character.

equipped_count.title: Equipped Count
equipped_count.desc: Returns the count of items with `system.equipped:true` on the owning actor, optionally filtered by category. Type a free-form category string (matches `system.category` on the item, Cyrillic / Latin / any text). Leave empty or `any` to count all equipped items.

fields.label: Category
fields.placeholder: any (or item category, e.g. weapon / оружие / магия)

act_delay.title: Delay
act_delay.desc: Waits the given number of milliseconds, then continues the exec chain.

act_loop.title: For Loop
act_loop.desc: Runs Body N times. Current iteration index is available as {__loopIndex}. After all iterations, exec goes to Done.

act_wait_for_event.title: Wait For Event
act_wait_for_event.desc: Pauses the exec chain until the first fire of a Foundry hook. Timeout is in milliseconds (0 = no timeout). Continues exec once the event fires.

random_pick.title: Random Pick
random_pick.desc: Randomly returns one of the connected value inputs (up to 5). Empty inputs are skipped. Gives a uniform distribution.

resource_tier.title: Resource Tier
resource_tier.desc: Maps a number to a tier (e.g. HP → 'critical / bloodied / healthy'). Thresholds are a list of values; tier labels are a list one longer.

get_combat_state.title: Get Combat State
get_combat_state.desc: Value outputs about the current encounter: is combat active (0/1), current round, active combatant index, active combatant id/actor.

get_compendium_uuids.title: Compendium Item UUIDs
get_compendium_uuids.desc: Returns all item UUIDs in a compendium pack as an array. Drag a compendium from the sidebar into the Pack field or type its id (e.g. 'world.my-items' or 'system-director.weapons'). Feeds into Add Item Array, item array ops, etc.

get_compendium_count.title: Compendium Item Count
get_compendium_count.desc: Returns the number of items in a compendium pack.

get_compendium_names.title: Compendium Item Names
get_compendium_names.desc: Returns the names of all items in a compendium pack as an array (comma-joined).

var_read.title: Read Variable
var_read.desc: Reads a variable by scope. Local — within a single press. Actor — on the actor (persists). World — in system settings.

var_write.title: Write Variable
var_write.desc: Writes a variable by scope. Local lasts until the end of the current graph pass. Actor is stored in actor.flags.sd.vars. World goes into game.settings.

var_get.title: Get Variable
var_get.desc: Reads the value of a local graph variable. Variables are defined in the Variables panel of the graph editor.

var_set.title: Set Variable
var_set.desc: Assigns a value to a local graph variable. Variables live within a single button press (per-run).

cast_to_actor.title: Cast to Actor
cast_to_actor.desc: Attempts to cast Value (UUID string) to an Actor. On success, emits Cast Success with ActorId; otherwise Cast Failed.

cast_to_item.title: Cast to Item
cast_to_item.desc: Attempts to cast Value (UUID string) to an Item. On success, emits Cast Success with ItemId; otherwise Cast Failed.

macro_input.title: Macro Input
macro_input.desc: Entry point for a nested graph (macro). Macro ID must match the ID in macro_call. Exec and up to 4 value pins are forwarded from macro_call.

macro_output.title: Macro Output
macro_output.desc: Exit point of a nested graph. Placed INSIDE the macro graph. Exec and up to 2 value pins are returned out to macro_call.

macro_call.title: Call Macro
macro_call.desc: Calls a nested macro graph by ID. The macro must be defined in the Macros panel of the graph editor. Return values are available via value pins.

act_show_journal.title: Show Journal
act_show_journal.desc: Render a JournalEntry to the player. If 'Force show to all' is enabled, GM pushes the entry to every connected player.

act_journal_show_page.title: Show Journal Page
act_journal_show_page.desc: Open a specific JournalEntryPage. If the page is an image type — Foundry shows it as a popup handout; text/markdown opens the journal sheet at that page.

act_reset_roll_table.title: Reset Roll Table
act_reset_roll_table.desc: Resets the 'drawn' state of all results in a RollTable. Useful for no-replacement tables — once exhausted, call this to make every result available again.

act_show_roll_table.title: Show Roll Table
act_show_roll_table.desc: Open a RollTable's sheet for inspection. GM additionally pushes it to all players (handy for shared 'fortune' or 'omen' tables).

act_card_shuffle.title: Shuffle Deck
act_card_shuffle.desc: Shuffle a Cards stack (deck or discard pile). Posts a chat notification by default.

act_card_draw.title: Draw Cards
act_card_draw.desc: Draw N cards from one stack (deck) into another (hand). Found→ fires when at least one card was drawn — exposes {__lastDrawnCard} and {__lastDrawnCards}. Empty→ fires when the source stack has no available cards.

act_card_play.title: Play Card
act_card_play.desc: Play (publicly reveal & discard) a card from a hand or pile. Posts a chat card showing the face. Selector: top / random / first / by_name / specific (cardId).

act_card_discard.title: Discard Card
act_card_discard.desc: Silently move a card from a hand to its source deck's discard pile (no public chat-card). Useful for resource-as-cards (reagents, hero points).

act_card_reveal.title: Reveal Card
act_card_reveal.desc: Post a chat-card showing a card's face (image + name + description) WITHOUT moving it. The card stays where it is.

act_card_pass.title: Pass Card
act_card_pass.desc: Pass a card from one stack to another (e.g. give a card to another player). Posts a chat notification by default.

act_card_recall.title: Recall Cards
act_card_recall.desc: Return all cards (from hands and piles) back to this deck — Foundry's Cards.recall(). Use to reset the game between sessions or shuffle a fresh starting deck.

act_card_deal.title: Deal Cards
act_card_deal.desc: Deal N cards from a source deck to multiple destination hands (comma- or semicolon-separated names/UUIDs). E.g. 'Aelyn's Hand, Boric's Hand, Lyra's Hand'.

fields.label: To stacks (CSV of names or UUIDs)

act_card_flip.title: Flip Card(s)
act_card_flip.desc: Toggle a card's face vs back. Use cardId='*' (or leave blank with selector='*') to flip ALL cards in the stack at once.

get_card.title: Get Card
get_card.desc: Pure source — read properties of a single card from a Cards stack. Pick the stack by name or UUID and choose which card to read via the selector. All outputs reflect the same card. cardId field is used only when selector=specific; cardName when selector=by_name.

stack_info.title: Stack Info
stack_info.desc: Pure source — read statistics for a Cards stack. count = total cards, availableCount = cards with drawn=false, drawnCount = drawn=true count, isEmpty = 1 when nothing available, topCardId / bottomCardId = current first/last available card id.

on_card_drawn.title: On Card Drawn
on_card_drawn.desc: Fires when a Card document is created in the configured Cards stack (i.e. when a card is drawn into this hand / pile). Filter by stack name or UUID. Outputs expose the drawn card's id, name, face index, value, and parent stack info.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_quest_activated.title: On Quest Activated
on_quest_activated.desc: Fires when a quest in this QuestLog becomes active on any actor. Outputs the actor and quest involved.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_quest_completed.title: On Quest Completed
on_quest_completed.desc: Fires when a quest in this QuestLog is marked Completed.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_quest_failed.title: On Quest Failed
on_quest_failed.desc: Fires when a quest in this QuestLog is marked Failed.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_subtask_done.title: On Subtask Done
on_subtask_done.desc: Fires when a subtask of a quest in this QuestLog is marked done.

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

on_quest_revealed.title: On GM Reveal
on_quest_revealed.desc: Fires when GM toggles 'Reveal' on a quest in this QuestLog (visible-to-players override).

fields.label: Standalone (fire when item is not on an actor)

quest_activate.title: Activate Quest
quest_activate.desc: Set status of a quest to 'active'. If 'Set on actor' is wired or filled, also writes actor.system.activeQuest.

fields.label: Quest Id (default — this quest's id, or filter)

quest_complete.title: Complete Quest
quest_complete.desc: Set status of a quest to 'completed' and fire sdQuestCompleted hook.

quest_fail.title: Fail Quest
quest_fail.desc: Set status of a quest to 'failed' and fire sdQuestFailed.

quest_lock.title: Lock Quest
quest_lock.desc: Set status of a quest to 'locked' (hidden from players regardless of visibility).

quest_make_available.title: Make Quest Available
quest_make_available.desc: Set status of a quest to 'available' (unlocked for activation).

subtask_set_done.title: Set Subtask Done
subtask_set_done.desc: Mark a subtask done/undone. Fires sdSubtaskDone when becoming done.

quest_show_to_player.title: Show Quest To Player
quest_show_to_player.desc: Add a player (userId) to a quest's perPlayer visibility list. Switches mode to 'perPlayer' if not already.

quest_toggle_gm_reveal.title: Toggle GM Reveal
quest_toggle_gm_reveal.desc: Toggle the GM 'Revealed' override on a quest (makes it visible to players regardless of visibility mode).

reward_reveal.title: Reveal Reward
reward_reveal.desc: Toggle GM-reveal on a reward — overrides hidden/onCompletion/conditional visibility so players can see it.

reward_make_claimable.title: Make Reward Claimable
reward_make_claimable.desc: Set the reward's 'claimable' flag, enabling/disabling the player's Claim button.

reward_grant_all.title: Grant Reward To All
reward_grant_all.desc: Force-grant a reward to every player who has a character (skips claim, applies items/currency/path-changes).

quest_status.title: Quest Status
quest_status.desc: Pure source — read the current status of a quest as a string ('locked'/'available'/'active'/'completed'/'failed').

quest_is_active.title: Quest Is Active?
quest_is_active.desc: Pure source — true if a quest's status is 'active' (regardless of which actor).

subtask_done.title: Subtask Done?
subtask_done.desc: Pure source — true if a subtask is marked done.

current_user_id.title: Current User
current_user_id.desc: Pure source — id and role of the user the script runs for.

actor_on_scene.title: Actor On Scene?
actor_on_scene.desc: Pure source — true if the given actor (by id or name) has at least one token on the currently viewed scene.

field_equals.title: Field Value Equals?
field_equals.desc: Pure source — true if a path on a referenced actor equals the given value (string compare). Use to gate quest progress on actor stats / flags.
